experience.ecbase: Remote medior full-stack role building product UIs for a backoffice ERP: warehouse management, whitelabel B2B ordering (web + mobile), and shared frontend work. Grew from a long freelance engagement into a multi-year product engineering role.
experience.freelance: Through Kurbo and as an independent founder I ship websites and apps for clients, plus my own products — Sonid (music education), Directus Mobile (CMS client), Capo, Toka, Classroom, and earlier experiments like Meta: Assembled.
